note: City of Hillsboro campground on a wooded peninsula in Lake Hillsboro. Mostly seasonal: 113 permanent sites and 16 short-term sites, so expect long-term campers around the nightly ones. Electric at every site (amperage not published); shower house and a second comfort station, playground, pavilions. Call the campground for a short-term site. --Claude
